subject: Resident
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a clean grayscale pencil-and-ink 3D MODELING REFERENCE SKETCH SHEET for Fire Slop, a comic stylized rescue game. White background, confident dark contours, very light gray planar shading, simplified chunky low-poly-friendly geometry, few large details. NOT a photoreal render, NOT a screenshot. One consistent object design across all views, uncluttered generous separation, all silhouettes fully in frame. Landscape sheet. Large three-quarter hero view plus smaller aligned front, side and rear or top views as appropriate. Minimal English view labels and title only; no invented dimension numbers, no watermark, no flames, smoke, UI or scene clutter. Shapes must be clear enough for a 3D artist to reconstruct. Title: Resident. Use the attached image only as a character proportion/style reference. Draw the rescued civilian, not the firefighter: a worried but funny adult male with very large protruding round eyes, thick eyebrows, swept simple solid hair, short stout body, oversized head, hoodie, simple trousers and sneakers. Develop an original closely related design. No oxygen mask or hose, no gloves or helmet. Front, profile and back in matching relaxed A-pose, plus expressive three-quarter view. Clear separated arms and legs, simple mitten-like hands with thumb. Hoodie hood visible on the back; no intricate strings. Same proportions throughout.
notes: Oversized eyes and head, hoodie and short limbs. Use the aligned views for a neutral rigging pose; the large view supplies expression.
